literal_meaning: পুরো নিয়ম বা রীতি অনুসারে (full custom or intact rule)
figurative_meaning_en: intact; to the full extent; completely; entirely
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে পুরাদস্তুর সুস্থ আছে, কোনো সমস্যা নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: He is perfectly fine, no issues at all.
One should prepare completely for the exam.
history: Derived from the Persian word 'dastur' meaning custom or rule, implying something done fully according to established norms.
note: The idiom emphasizes wholeness and is widely used in colloquial Bengali to denote completeness without alteration.
